name: English
note: Key = the Chinese source string. Missing keys fall back to Chinese. Use {name} / {n} for interpolation.

strings.我是饺子，住在这台机器里: I'm Jiaozi. I live inside this machine.
strings.我能看见你的文件、运行命令、打开窗口。<br>我们用的是同一个桌面。:
I can see your files, run commands and open windows.
We share the same desktop.
strings.让饺子做点什么…（Enter 发送，Shift+Enter 换行）: Ask Jiaozi to do something… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
strings.搜索应用、文件或问 AI: Search apps, files, or ask the AI
strings.已从界面中断。模型可能仍在后台收尾，稍后可以再问我。: Interrupted from the UI. The model may still be finishing in the background — ask me again in a moment.
strings.本轮没有返回内容。检查模型服务是否在线。: Nothing came back this turn. Check whether the model service is online.
strings.让饺子做点什么…（点右侧按钮发送）: Ask Jiaozi to do something… (tap the button on the right to send)
strings.在另一台机器上打开饺子；或者在上面填对方的 IP 和配对码。: Open Jiaozi on another machine, or fill in its IP and pairing code above.
strings.公共 WiFi 常禁组播，发现不到不代表连不上。: Public Wi-Fi often blocks multicast — not being discovered doesn't mean you can't connect.
strings.在另一台设备的「设备」里填：: On the other device's Devices app, enter:
strings.断开与「{name}」的配对？之后要重新输入配对码。: Unpair from {name}? You'll need the pairing code again.
strings.不知道对方地址，等它在线再试: Peer address unknown — wait until it comes online
strings.浏览器拦了弹窗，请允许后重试: The browser blocked the popup. Allow it and try again.
strings.已把句子填进 AI 输入框，补完回车即可: Sentence placed in the AI input — finish it and press Enter
strings.在「{name}」上点「生成配对码」，把 6 位数字填进来: On {name}, tap Generate code, then type the 6 digits here
strings.仅载入前部分内容，保存会覆盖全文: Only the first part was loaded; saving will overwrite the whole file
strings.重新载入会用磁盘上的内容覆盖当前编辑。: Reloading will overwrite your edits with what is on disk.
strings.文件会进入回收站（~/.jiaozi/trash），可以手动找回。: The file goes to the trash (~/.jiaozi/trash) and can be restored by hand.
strings.任何 OpenAI 兼容端点都能用。本机跑小模型推荐 Ollama 或 llam: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works. For small local models, Ollama or llama.cpp server is recommended — it keeps working offline.
strings.API Key（本机模型留空）: API key (leave empty for local models)
strings.已设置，留空则不修改: Set — leave empty to keep it
strings.模型支持 tools 参数时开启；0.5B~3B 小模型建议关闭，走提示协议更稳: Turn on when the model supports the tools parameter; for 0.5B–3B models leave it off — the prompt protocol is steadier.
strings.逐字显示回复；个别老服务端不支持可关闭。: Shows the reply token by token; turn it off if an older server doesn't support it.
strings.让 AI 真的画出图片，并保存成你硬盘上的文件。接口地址和 Key 留空时，会复: Lets the AI actually draw images and save them as files on your disk. Leave endpoint and key empty to reuse the AI model settings.
strings.留空复用上面的地址，例如 https://apihub.agnes-ai.com: Leave empty to reuse the endpoint above, e.g. https://apihub.agnes-ai.com/v1
strings.已单独设置，留空则不修改: Set separately — leave empty to keep it
strings.留空复用上面的 Key: Leave empty to reuse the key above
strings.保存目录（须在沙箱内）: Save folder (must be inside the sandbox)
strings.关掉后 AI 调 image_gen 会直接报错，不会产生费用。: When off, image_gen returns an error and costs nothing.
strings.决定饺子能做多大的事、需要多少次确认。开发板上建议把步数调小以控制延迟。: Decides how much Jiaozi may do and how often it asks. On a dev board, keep steps low to control latency.
strings.允许机器人/外部设备通过 /api/device/task 调用本机大脑。: Lets robots or external devices call this machine's brain via /api/device/task.
strings.同样的桌面，手机和电脑上看起来都合适。: The same desktop, sized for both phones and desktops.
strings.浅色适合白天，深色适合夜间和开发板小屏。: Light suits daytime; dark suits night and small dev-board screens.
strings.默认自动判断：先看你的系统和浏览器语言，认不出来再按 IP 归属地。手动选过一次: Automatic by default: your system and browser language first, then IP location. Once you pick one by hand it stops changing on its own.
strings.选完会立即重新加载界面。: The interface reloads as soon as you pick.
strings.目前翻好的语言：简体中文、繁體中文、English、日本語、한국어、Deutsc: Languages so far: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian. Adding one is a single JSON file in desktop/i18n/ — no code changes.
strings.AI 和文件管理器只能在这些目录里活动。加一个根目录就等于把那份数据交给它。: The AI and the file manager can only work inside these folders. Adding a root hands that data over.
strings.超过这个大小的文件需要走命令行拷贝。: Larger files have to be copied from the command line.
strings.同一个 WiFi 下的其他饺子会出现在「设备」里，配对之后就能互相调用工具——比: Other Jiaozi instances on the same Wi-Fi show up in Devices; once paired they can call each other's tools — for example driving this computer from your phone. Changes apply on save.
strings.每 5 秒向局域网发一次组播。公共 WiFi 常禁组播——关掉之后仍然可以在「设: Multicasts once every 5 seconds. Public Wi-Fi often blocks it — you can still pair by IP in the Devices app.
strings.允许别的东西调用本机: Allow others to call this machine
strings.关闭后本机不再提供跨设备执行接口，已配对的对端全部失效。给自己留条后路，别在远程: When off, this machine stops serving cross-device execution and every paired peer stops working. Keep a way back — don't turn it off while working remotely.
strings.配对不需要密码，也不需要记 IP：在对方那台点「生成配对码」，在这台输入 6 位: Pairing needs no password and no memorised IP: tap Generate code on the other machine and type the 6 digits here. The code is single-use, expires in 5 minutes and dies after 6 wrong tries.
strings.让每一台 Linux 设备都有一个能看、能动手的桌面: Give every Linux device a desktop you can see and touch
strings.人和 AI 共用同一张桌子: Humans and AI share the same desk
strings.用手机/平板打开同一地址即可进入这个桌面（需要带 token）。: Open the same address on your phone or tablet to enter this desktop (token required).
strings.开源项目 · 无遥测 · 数据全部留在本机: Open source · no telemetry · data never leaves your machine
strings.如果和现在的界面语言不同，把上面选成「自动」再保存即可切过去。: If it differs from the current language, set the menu above to Automatic and save to switch.
strings.我是饺子，住在这台机器里。左边是我的对话窗，直接吩咐就行。: I'm Jiaozi, living inside this machine. My chat is on the left — just tell me what to do.
strings.桌面和 AI 共用同一份文件。你改的、我改的，都是同一个。: The desktop and the AI share the same files. What you change and what I change are one and the same.
strings.只是关掉浏览器页面。服务端还在运行，重新打开地址即可回来。: This only closes the browser tab. The server keeps running — reopen the address to come back.
strings.（可能没有 Desktop 目录，试试在文件管理器里新建）: (there may be no Desktop folder — try creating it in the file manager)
strings.ESP32 通电并连上同一个 WiFi，就会自动出现在这里。: Power up an ESP32 on the same WiFi and it appears here by itself.
strings.搜不到就点「手动添加」，填设备的 IP。: Not showing up? Use "Add manually" and enter the device IP.
strings.装了识别后端，AI 输入框旁边才会出现麦克风。音频在你按住说话时就地编码成 WA: The mic only appears once a speech backend is configured. Audio is encoded to WAV right here in your browser and sent only to that backend.
strings.放 tokens.txt 和 model.onnx 的目录。填了它就优先本地识别: Directory containing tokens.txt and model.onnx. If set, recognition runs locally and audio never leaves this machine.
strings.打开「一直听」时，只有说到这个词开头的句子才会被执行，其他当闲聊丢掉。: With always-listening on, only sentences starting with this word are executed; everything else is ignored.
strings.打开 AI 面板时默认一直听: Start listening as soon as the AI panel opens
strings.关掉的话就是点一下说一句。一直听会持续占用麦克风，手机上比较费电。: Off means tap once per sentence. Always-listening keeps the mic open and drains phone batteries.
